[SWS_DM_02007] Providing
EID
using
MAC
of network interface
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_00026
⌈
If
DoIpNetworkConfiguration.eidRetrieval
is configured with
DoIpEi-
dRetrievalEnum.eidUseMac

of net-
